thread:
Aaron: Quick sync — follow-up from last night's staged deploy where the quota limiter hit at ~10% traffic and we saw degraded downstream retries. Need clear owners + timelines for: auto-rollback, smaller flag scope, blast-radius caps, and telemetry. Who can pick which?
Maya: I can own auto-rollback. Plan: implement a canary failure detector + a simple `--auto-rollback` controller that watches error rate and traffic %; target: prototype PR by EOD Thu, rollout by next Tue if tests pass. Will add runbook snippet in PR. :+1:
Leo: I can take blast-radius controls + canary sampling. Proposal: hard cap canary to 2 regions and max 5% traffic, add safety quota circuit in front of new flags. Timeline: design doc by Wed, config change staged Fri.
Priya: I'll handle flag scoping and telemetry. Immediate step is to reduce the flag's audience (remove the 50% ramp step), and add a per-flag error-rate metric to dashboard. Want the dashboard and alert (pager if >1% 5m) by Monday.
Zach: For tests — I'll add a gating e2e that simulates quota-exhaustion and validates rollback path. Can do test harness + CI job by next week.
oncall-bot: Incident #1291 (staged deploy quota limiter) link: https://incidents.redwood/1291 — postmortem draft: https://docs.redwood/postmortems/1291
Maya: Quick tech notes: pseudo for rollback detector: ```
if canary_error_rate > threshold and canary_traffic_pct > min_pct:
  trigger_rollback(flag_id)
```
We should make threshold and min_pct configurable per-flag.
Leo: Also suggest a soft-fallback model routing step (route to smaller model variant) as part of rollout policy so failures don't cascade. Not high effort if we reuse existing routing policy code.
Aaron: Great — assign owners in tracker: Maya = auto-rollback (PR due Thu), Leo = blast-radius & sampling (design Wed, config Fri), Priya = flag scope + telemetry (dashboard Mon), Zach = gating tests (CI job next week). Can everyone add a checklist item in the postmortem doc and post their PR links here when opened?
Priya: Added checklist item and initial dashboard wireframe in the postmortem doc. I'll ping infra for alerting thresholds.
Maya: I'll schedule a 30m handoff sync (tomorrow 10am PT) to walk through the rollback controller interface. Invite sent.
Zach: Noted — I'll add the e2e test matrix to the checklist.
Aaron: Thanks all. Let's treat this as high priority — if any blocker, call it out here. Will mark follow-up meeting: next Tue 9am to confirm rollouts. :calendar:
